scripts.build: npm run build:engine && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:e2e: npm run build:engine && tsc -b && cross-env VITE_ENABLE_TEST_HOOKS=true vite build
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.benchmark:ai: cargo run --locked --release --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml -p jungle-cli -- arena --candidate self --champion python --champion-arg -m --champion-arg tools.legacy_engine_jsonl --smoke --time-ms 80 --max-pairs 1 --bootstrap-samples 1000 --pretty
scripts.test:all: npm run verify:python && npm run test:python && npm run lint:rust && npm run test:rust && npm run test:artifacts && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
scripts.deploy: wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name gpt-jungle --branch main
